name: Attica — Athena, Poseidon, Cecrops, Olive, Sea, Verdict, and the Remembered Counter-Claim
description: The whole relational image: claim and witness, verdict and flood, variant aftermaths, the sanctuary that remembers both claims, the ratified toroidal reading and olive chain, and the verdict returned to the place.

scenes.name: Claim, witness, verdict
scenes.character: Poseidon strikes the middle of the Acropolis; Athena calls Cecrops to witness and plants the olive; Zeus separates; the twelve arbiters award the country on Cecrops's testimony; the city is named Athens.

entities.name: the Acropolis — the claimed middle of the city
Poseidon's trident — the strike that opens the sea
Cecrops — the earth-born witness, man and serpent

text.title: Claim, witness, verdict
text.italic: Two signs; the witness sees both; the name follows the testimony.

scenes.name: The flood and its variant aftermaths
scenes.character: Poseidon floods the Thriasian plain; Hyginus has Mercury prevent the inundation; Augustine's Varro-derived telling takes the women's votes and the maternal names away.

entities.name: the Thriasian flood — the plain under the sea
the flood spreading — three variant aftermaths
the west pediment — the contest carved in stone

text.title: Variant aftermaths
text.italic: Poseidon floods the plain; Hyginus prevents; Augustine takes the vote back.

scenes.name: The sanctuary remembers both claims
scenes.character: The Erechtheion houses Athena's eastern room and Poseidon-Erechtheus below; the olive, the trident marks and the salt spring stand in the sacred centre; the burnt shoot regrows.

entities.name: the Erechtheion — Athena east, Poseidon-Erechtheus below
the sacred olive — burnt, and the shoot by morning
the salt cistern — the wave that sounds in a south wind

text.title: The sanctuary remembers both claims
text.italic: Burnt to a stump, the olive answers by morning.

scenes.name: The ratified reading: the well at the centre; the olive chain
scenes.character: The civic-rational order organised around an opening it cannot convert into itself; root → tree → fruit → pressing → oil → anointing → flame; a valid verdict is not an exhaustive ontology.

entities.name: the civic order wound around the well
the olive chain — root, tree, fruit, pressing, oil, flame

text.title: Poseidon's well at the centre
text.italic: The city is ordered around a depth it cannot fill.

scenes.name: The verdict returns to the place
scenes.character: Five candidates held as candidates; the whole-story method; the Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio fourfold as operational analogy.

entities.name: the retained contrary — Poseidon's force with standing
the fourfold — place, signs, verdict, belonging
the shared ground held with Neumann's morphology

text.title: The verdict returns to the place
text.italic: It binds the city; it does not exhaust the place.
